sections_target.text: This document sets out the steps

rows: A work order must be opened
The unit is out of service and in test position
Disconnect the processing unit supply when changing power supplies or fans
Remove the filters from the cabinet doors
Clean the cabinet cards with the blower
Clean and wash the filters, then dry them and refit them
Check all fans, including the power supply fans, and replace any faulty one
Check the output voltages of the power supplies and adjust them as per the table
Visual check of the condition of the cards and replacement of any faulty one
Check the signals in coordination with the different departments
